p: arise: The prophet shows that even though God permits the wicked tyrants to oppress his Church for a time, yet eventually he will take revenge on them.
But let the righteous be glad: He shows that when God declares his power against the wicked, it is for the convenience and salvation of his Church, who praise him for it.

JAH: Jah and Jehovah are the names of God, signifying his incomprehensible essence and majesty, so that by this it is declared that all idols are vanity and that the God of Israel is the only true God.
setteth the solitary in families: He gives children to those who are childless, and increases their families.
dry land: Which is devoid of God's blessings, which before they had abused.
O God: He teaches that God's favour belongs specifically to his Church as appears by their wonderful deliverance out of Egypt.
goodness for the poor: God blessed the land of Canaan, because he had chosen that place for his Church.
those that published it: The fashion then was that women sang songs after the victory, as did Miriam, Deborah, Judith and others.
she that tarried at home divided: The prayer was so great, that not only the soldiers, but the women also had part of it.
pots: Though God permits his Church for a time to lie in black darkness, yet he will restore it, and make it most shining and white.
in it: In the land of Canaan, where his Church was.
The hill of God is as: Zion the Church of God exceeds all worldly things, not in pomp and outward show, but by the inward grace of God, which remains because of his dwelling there.
Why leap ye: Why do you boast of your strength and beauty against this Mountain of God.

led captivity captive: As God overcame the enemy of his Church, took them prisoners, and made them tributaries: so Christ, which is God manifested in the flesh, subdued Satan and sin under us, and gave to his Church most liberal gifts of his Spirit, Eph 4:8.
issues from death: Even in most extreme dangers, God has infinite ways to deliver his.
Bashan: As he delivered his Church once from Og of Bashan and other tyrants and from the danger of the Red Sea, so will he still do as often as it is necessary.
in the same: That is, in the blood of that great slaughter, where dogs will lap blood.
thy goings: That is, how you who are chief King goes out with your people to war, and gives them the victory.
singers went before: He describes the order of the people, when they went to the temple to give thanks for the victory.
of Israel: Who come of the patriarch Jacob.
little Benjamin with their: Benjamin is called little, because he was the youngest son of Jacob.
ruler: Who was some chief ruler of the tribe.
Because of thy temple at Jerusalem: Declare out of your holy palace your power for the defence of your Church Jerusalem.

submit himself with pieces of silver: He desires that the pride of the mighty may be destroyed, who were accustomed to garnishing their shoes with silver, and therefore for their glittering pomp thought themselves above all men.
of Egypt: He prophecies that the Gentiles will come to the true knowledge and worship of God.
voice: By his terrible thunders he will make himself be known as the God of all the world.
terrible out of thy holy: In showing fearful judgments against your enemies for the salvation of your people.
places: He alludes to the tabernacle which was divided in three parts.
